title: A2v10 metadata.json (report)
description: A report: a window into a surface, no data of its own. Declares the SUBSET that may be asked, not a query - the client picks one inside it at runtime. surface >= subset >= query: the first is checked at build, the second at runtime. Not here: SQL, presentation, captions, the user's saved choice. Irregular report -> eject to a handler. Enum values are PascalCase.

description.description: For the model, not the platform: nothing reads it - no generator, runtime or deploy. Where the model writes down what it must know about this endpoint - its rules and the reasons for them - so the next session finds them here.

type.description: Form of the answer. One today: 'turnover' - opening balance, movements of the period, closing balance.

surface.description: Journal this report reads, e.g. '/journal/stock'. Not 'table' or 'storage': a report owns no rows and inherits no declaration.

groups.description: Dimensions offered for grouping, resolved into the surface at build. Order here is order in the taskpad - there is no 'order' key.

filters.description: Dimensions offered for filtering. Resolved and ordered as 'groups'.

data.description: Measures offered for display, resolved into the surface at build.

defaults.description: Ticked on open. Each name repeats one from the list it belongs to; absent there - refused at build. No 'filters' here: a filter opens empty.
